# Code only

Run the build and read the log.

```text
It's worth noting that this robust pipeline leverages a seamless, holistic,
comprehensive approach. This may potentially fail in some cases — or not — ever.
This isn't just a tool, not a toy. So what does this mean?
```

Pass `--robust`, `leverage`, and `It's worth noting` as literal flags; the
`comprehensive` option stays off.
